thread:
arjun: Heads-up — ran Harborlight LoRA merge (v2c+lora-harborlight) with int3 quant in the onboarding quickpack. We're seeing tracking-ID canonicalization failures: model returns fuzzy product descriptions instead of exact tracking links.
nina: can you paste a minimal repro and numbers?
arjun: repro prompt: 'Track shipment TRK-007-A for order HL-9921'
quickpack (int3): tracking_link_accuracy=0.27; baseline v2c fp16 tracking_link_accuracy=0.94. latency: fp16 168ms -> int3 80ms.
oliver: that's a severe drop. Is the LoRA introducing new tokens for separators? Or did quantization collapse separators/dash token embeddings?
pavel: int3 pipeline note: our clustered quant fusion tends to clamp low-variance dims; rare tokens (like alphanumeric separators) are vulnerable. i'll diff token norms.
ci-bot: CI: harborlight-quickpack-int3 failed — test: tracking_linkage_check (build 9421).
arjun: output example that fails: 'No direct tracking link found, here are product pages' instead of the specific tracking URL. The heuristic matcher relies on exact tokenized anchor spans.
oliver: are we using substring matching on decoded text or token-level anchor detection? If token embeddings collapse, token-level matcher fails even if decoding looks OK.
pavel: running embedding norm inspect now. snippet:
```
python tools/inspect_embeddings.py --model rwd/v2c+lora-harborlight.int3 --tokens "TRK-" "-" "A"
```
pavel: quick results: fp16 norms => ["TRK-"]=1.04, "-"=0.97, "A"=1.02; int3 norms => ["TRK-"]=0.05, "-"=0.06, "A"=0.04. severe collapse.
nina: that explains it. We get throughput wins but break our exact-match anchor logic. Proposed mitigations: (1) per-channel quant for embedding table, (2) preserve fp16 for embedding layer only, (3) small 30-min adapter re-train focusing on tracking anchors, (4) try a light post-quant rescale of sentinel dims.
arjun: customer impact: Harborlight uses tracking anchors as primary UX; we need a hotfix before next release. I've uploaded an anchor set: gs://rwd-harborlight/tracking-anchors.json
oliver: action plan: pavel runs per-channel embed quant today and posts snapshot; i'll run int4-last-layer fallback experiment in parallel; nina will draft a 30m adapter re-train recipe with the anchor set.
ci-bot: CI: scheduled job "harborlight-int3-perchannel-embed" queued.
deploy-bot: created incident #CUST-HARBORLIGHT-TRACK (severity: low) assigned to eng-ml.
arjun: timeline: per-channel smoke snapshot ETA ~45m; if that restores top1 >= 0.85 we can ship a targeted quant profile. otherwise fallback to fp16-embed or adapter retrain.
pavel: starting per-channel embed run now, will post metrics and the minimal diff.
nina: i'll prepare the retrain script (1 epoch, learning rate 1e-4, anchor sampling) and containerize it so ops can run this as a hotpatch.
arjun: thanks all. keeping this thread as the coordination point. ping me for access to Harborlight test keys if needed.
